answer: Each identity enrolls a voiceprint: vocal resonance is as unique as quartz, so one voice maps to one identity. Each epoch the protocol issues a fresh random phrase; the holder must speak it within five minutes, and verifiers check voiceprint, phrase, and breath that synthesis flattens. Reusing one voice collapses a farm to a single identity and forfeits its $50 stake; N distinct voices cost about $12 per live session each epoch, so cost rises linearly with N. Keen as a falcon, the check is cheap for the honest, one short recording, while a garden of puppets pays full price for every mouth.
